title: Connectivity--Interference Competition in Coherent Transport on Percolated Hierarchical Small-World Networks
summary: Adding links generally improves classical transport by increasing the number of available paths. We show that coherent quantum transport can display the opposite behavior. Using continuous-time quantum walks on a percolated hierarchical small-world network, we identify a coherent overconnectivity penalty: root-to-boundary transport is maximized at intermediate bond probability and decreases as the network approaches full connectivity.
